name: gta6_impact
version: 1.0.0
profile: gta6_impact
model-paths:
- models
test-paths:
- data_tests
models:
  gta6_impact:
    staging:
      +materialized: view
    intermediate:
      +materialized: view
    marts:
      +materialized: table
vars:
  day_off_index_span_start: '2025-11-01'
  day_off_index_span_end: '2026-11-15'
  day_off_index_batch: 20261116T185310
  day_off_index_start_week: '2026-11-01'
  day_off_index_end_week: '2026-11-08'
  day_off_index_weeks: 2
  day_off_index_weeks_back: 52
  gta_v_date: '2013-09-17'
  gta_6_date: '2026-11-19'
  github_release_day: '2026-11-19'
  github_baseline_weeks: 1

version: 2
sources:
- name: raw
  schema: raw
  description: 'Public signals landed by `gta6 ingest` as Parquet under data/raw/ and loaded by `gta6
    load`. Every table is rebuilt from the files on each load; the newest pull wins per key. No post text,
    handles or usernames are stored.

    '
  tables:
  - name: wiki_pageviews
    description: Daily English Wikipedia pageviews by users (all access) per article.
  - name: trends_interest
    description: 'Google Trends relative interest (0-100) per term and day. Values only compare within
      one request_id; Google rescales every request to its own peak.

      '
  - name: bluesky_daily_hits
    description: 'Bluesky public search hitsTotal for one quoted seed phrase (optionally plus "gta") bounded
      to one UTC day. hits_total is NULL when the call failed.

      '
  - name: hn_daily_hits
    description: 'Hacker News (Algolia) nbHits for one quoted seed phrase (optionally plus "gta") over
      stories and comments in one UTC day. NULL when the call failed.

      '
  - name: economy_indicators
    description: 'Official economic data, one value per provider, indicator, geography and year: World
      Bank WDI world aggregates (WLD) and the IMF World Economic Outlook world series (WEOWORLD). A year
      a provider has not published is absent, never zero.'
  - name: github_daily_counts
    description: GitHub Search API total_count for one activity (prs_opened, prs_merged, commits) bounded
      to one UTC day, one call each. total_count is NULL when the call failed; incomplete_results is true
      when GitHub's search timed out (or the call failed). No repository, user, title or URL is stored.

-- One row per UTC day per GitHub activity, from one GitHub Search API call each (Metric 4).
-- activity_count is NULL when the call failed or GitHub flagged the result incomplete:
-- unavailable, never zero.
select
    cast(day as date) as activity_date,
    activity,
    endpoint,
    query,
    case
        when total_count is not null and not coalesce(incomplete_results, true)
            then cast(total_count as bigint)
    end as activity_count,
    total_count is not null and not coalesce(incomplete_results, true) as is_available,
    observed_at
from {{ source('raw', 'github_daily_counts') }}

version: 2
models:
- name: stg_github__daily_counts
  description: GitHub Search API daily counts, one row per UTC day per activity.
  columns:
  - name: activity_date
    description: UTC day the count covers.
  - name: activity
    description: prs_opened, prs_merged or commits.
  - name: endpoint
    description: GitHub search endpoint asked (issues or commits).
  - name: query
    description: The exact search query, bounded to the UTC day.
  - name: activity_count
    description: GitHub's total_count. NULL when unavailable, never zero.
  - name: is_available
    description: True when the call answered with a complete count.
  - name: observed_at
    description: When we asked (UTC).

-- Metric 4: GitHub activity per UTC day. One row per day per activity, for every day asked
-- for (release day, the weeks before it and the weeks after it).
{%- set release_day = var('github_release_day') %}
select
    md5(activity || '|' || cast(activity_date as varchar)) as github_day_key,
    activity_date,
    activity,
    case activity
        when 'prs_opened' then 'PRs opened'
        when 'prs_merged' then 'PRs merged'
        when 'commits' then 'Commits'
        else activity
    end as activity_label,
    activity_count,
    is_available,
    dayname(activity_date) as weekday_name,
    activity_date = date '{{ release_day }}' as is_release_day,
    cast(date_diff('day', date '{{ release_day }}', activity_date) as integer)
        as days_from_release,
    observed_at
from {{ ref('stg_github__daily_counts') }}

version: 2
models:
- name: fct_github_daily
  description: 'Metric 4: GitHub activity per UTC day, one row per day per activity.'
  columns:
  - name: github_day_key
    description: md5 of activity|day.
  - name: activity_date
    description: UTC day.
  - name: activity
    description: prs_opened, prs_merged or commits.
  - name: activity_label
    description: PRs opened, PRs merged or Commits.
  - name: activity_count
    description: How many on the day. NULL when unavailable, never zero.
  - name: is_available
    description: True when the day's count is complete.
  - name: weekday_name
    description: Day of the week.
  - name: is_release_day
    description: True on GTA 6's release day (var github_release_day).
  - name: days_from_release
    description: Days after release day (negative before it).
  - name: observed_at
    description: When the count was asked for (UTC).

-- Metric 4 breakdown: one row per GitHub activity. Release day's count against the median of
-- the same weekday in each of the weeks before it (vars github_release_day and
-- github_baseline_weeks; canonical: Thu 19 Nov 2026 vs the Thursday before, 12 Nov). A median,
-- so one bulk-import spike in the commit counts cannot move a longer baseline.
{%- set release_day = var('github_release_day') %}
{%- set weeks = var('github_baseline_weeks', 1) %}
with params as (
    select
        date '{{ release_day }}' as release_day,
        cast({{ weeks }} as integer) as baseline_weeks,
        cast(date '{{ release_day }}' - 7 * {{ weeks }} as date) as baseline_start,
        cast(date '{{ release_day }}' - 7 as date) as baseline_end
),

activities as (
    select distinct activity, activity_label
    from {{ ref('fct_github_daily') }}
),

per_activity as (
    select
        activities.activity,
        activities.activity_label,
        params.release_day,
        params.baseline_weeks,
        params.baseline_start,
        params.baseline_end,
        max(daily.activity_count) filter (
            where daily.activity_date = params.release_day
        ) as release_day_count,
        median(daily.activity_count) filter (
            where daily.activity_date between params.baseline_start and params.baseline_end
                and dayofweek(daily.activity_date) = dayofweek(params.release_day)
        ) as baseline_count,
        count(daily.activity_count) filter (
            where daily.activity_date between params.baseline_start and params.baseline_end
                and dayofweek(daily.activity_date) = dayofweek(params.release_day)
        ) as baseline_days_found
    from activities
    cross join params
    left join {{ ref('fct_github_daily') }} as daily
        on activities.activity = daily.activity
    group by
        activities.activity,
        activities.activity_label,
        params.release_day,
        params.baseline_weeks,
        params.baseline_start,
        params.baseline_end
)

select
    activity,
    activity_label,
    release_day,
    baseline_weeks,
    baseline_start,
    baseline_end,
    baseline_days_found,
    baseline_count,
    release_day_count,
    case
        when release_day_count is not null
            and baseline_days_found = baseline_weeks
            and baseline_count > 0
            then 100 * (release_day_count / baseline_count - 1)
    end as pct_change
from per_activity

version: 2
models:
- name: fct_github_release_day_activities
  description: 'Metric 4 breakdown: release day against the same weekday in the weeks before, one row
    per activity.'
  columns:
  - name: activity
    description: prs_opened, prs_merged or commits.
  - name: activity_label
    description: PRs opened, PRs merged or Commits.
  - name: release_day
    description: GTA 6's release day (var github_release_day).
  - name: baseline_weeks
    description: How many same weekdays before release day form the baseline.
  - name: baseline_start
    description: First baseline day.
  - name: baseline_end
    description: Last baseline day (a week before release day).
  - name: baseline_days_found
    description: Baseline days with a count.
  - name: baseline_count
    description: Median count over the baseline days (the day itself when there is one).
  - name: release_day_count
    description: Count on release day. NULL until the day is over and counted.
  - name: pct_change
    description: Release day against the baseline average, in percent.

-- Metric 4 headline: the average of the activities' release-day changes, in percent, one row
-- per release day. It always carries its breakdown: `breakdown` spells out every activity's
-- change, so the headline is never read without it.
select
    cast(release_day as varchar) as release_day_key,
    min(release_day) as release_day,
    min(baseline_start) as baseline_start,
    min(baseline_end) as baseline_end,
    min(baseline_weeks) as baseline_weeks,
    count(*) as activities_total,
    count(pct_change) as activities_available,
    case when count(pct_change) = count(*) then avg(pct_change) end as github_release_day_change,
    string_agg(
        activity_label || ' ' || coalesce(printf('%+.1f%%', pct_change), 'not yet available'),
        ' · ' order by activity desc
    ) as breakdown
from {{ ref('fct_github_release_day_activities') }}
group by release_day

version: 2
models:
- name: fct_github_release_day
  description: 'Metric 4 headline: average release-day change across activities, one row per release day,
    with its breakdown.'
  columns:
  - name: release_day_key
    description: 'Release day as text: the row''s key.'
  - name: release_day
    description: GTA 6's release day.
  - name: baseline_start
    description: First baseline day.
  - name: baseline_end
    description: Last baseline day.
  - name: baseline_weeks
    description: Baseline days (same weekday, weeks before).
  - name: activities_total
    description: Activities in the breakdown.
  - name: activities_available
    description: Activities with a change.
  - name: github_release_day_change
    description: Average of the activities' changes, in percent.
  - name: breakdown
    description: Every activity's change. Always report it with the headline.

-- The GitHub release-day change never travels without its breakdown.
select *
from {{ ref('fct_github_release_day') }}
where github_release_day_change is not null
    and (breakdown is null or activities_available <> activities_total)

declarations.description: GitHub Search API daily counts, one row per UTC day per activity.

population.rule: Every (day, activity) the ingester asked for; newest pull wins.

activity_count.null_rule: NULL when the call failed or GitHub flagged it incomplete.

assumptions.detail: AGENTS.md: a NULL is unavailable, never zero; a timed-out search is a lower bound, not the count

declarations.description: Metric 4: GitHub activity per UTC day, one row per day per activity.

population.rule: Every (day, activity) row in staging: 1 Oct 2026 onward, only fully ended UTC days.

activity_count.null_rule: NULL when unavailable, never zero. Never add across activities.

assumptions.chosen: PRs opened, PRs merged, commits (GitHub Search API total_count)
assumptions.detail: user: metric 4 is GitHub PRs / commits; docs/metrics.md names the Search API `is:pr created:<day>`

assumptions.chosen: UTC day, first to last second
assumptions.detail: config.py: all days in this study are UTC days

declarations.description: Metric 4 breakdown: release day against the median of the same weekday in the weeks before it (canonical: the Thursday before), one row per activity.

population.rule: One row per activity present in fct_github_daily, whether or not release day has been counted yet.

baseline_count.null_rule: NULL when no baseline day has a count.

release_day_count.null_rule: NULL until release day has ended and been counted.

pct_change.null_rule: NULL unless release day and every baseline day have a count.

assumptions.decision: What release day is compared with
assumptions.chosen: the same weekday a week before (Thu 12 Nov 2026); a median when github_baseline_weeks > 1
assumptions.detail: profiled (.dex/review/154): strong weekly cycle, and PRs opened grew from 1.15M (22 Oct) to 1.35M (12 Nov) on Thursdays, so older weeks understate a normal 19 Nov; commits carry bulk-import spikes (16.4M on 5 Nov vs ~12.9M), hence a median for longer baselines. No US holiday on 12 Nov

assumptions.decision: A baseline day without a count
assumptions.detail: an average over fewer days would be a different baseline

declarations.description: Metric 4 headline: the average of the activities' release-day changes, one row per release day, with its breakdown.

population.rule: One row for the configured release day (var github_release_day).

github_release_day_change.null_rule: NULL until every activity has a change.

assumptions.chosen: plain average of the per-activity percent changes
assumptions.detail: the Day-Off Index averages its phrases' changes the same way; counts differ by 10x between PRs and commits, so changes are averaged, not counts
fct_day_off_index: an average over fewer parts is a different number
